Polished the changelog timeline with month-specific URLs, a refined monochrome slider, clearer solid and dashed date connectors, softer date labels, and a simplified layout. Added crawler guidance, structured metadata, and a sitemap covering public guides and monthly changelogs. Redesigned the homepage with a cosmic player illustration, feature cards, and solid card backgrounds, then added topic-specific artwork to blog posts and the Contact page header. Integrated Adsterra Native Banner and fixed-size ads into the dashboard, page-bottom, and sidebar placements, with consent-aware loading and route-change refresh handling. Refined mobile search glow alignment, blog controls and typography, and changelog timeline markers and connectors. Improved the Audio Delay Test tap button so it flashes white only in response to a tap. Reversed changelog month and entry order, displayed summary details as bullets, corrected slider fill direction, and kept the page scroll anchored when switching months.
